fn io() -> ::std::result::Result<u32, ::std::io::Error> { ::std::result::Result::Ok(1) }
fn other_io() -> ::std::result::Result<u32, ::std::io::Error> { ::std::result::Result::Ok(2) }
fn parse() -> ::std::result::Result<u32, ::std::num::ParseIntError> { "3".parse() }
fn utf8() -> ::std::result::Result<u32, ::std::str::Utf8Error> {
    ::std::str::from_utf8(b"4").map(|_| 4)
}
fn float() -> ::std::result::Result<f32, ::std::num::ParseFloatError> { "5".parse() }

fn a() -> u32 { io().unwrap() + parse().unwrap() }
fn a_again() -> u32 { a() }
fn a_third() -> u32 { a() + a_again() }
fn b() -> u32 { io().unwrap() + utf8().unwrap() }
fn b_again() -> u32 { b() }
fn b_third() -> u32 { b() + b_again() }
fn nested() -> u32 { a() + b() }
fn nested_again() -> u32 { nested() }
fn nested_third() -> u32 { nested() + nested_again() }
fn single() -> u32 { io().unwrap() }
fn single_again() -> u32 { single() }
fn single_third() -> u32 { single() + single_again() }
fn utf8_only() -> u32 { utf8().unwrap() }
fn utf8_again() -> u32 { utf8_only() }
fn utf8_third() -> u32 { utf8_only() + utf8_again() }
fn float_only() -> u32 { float().unwrap() as u32 }
fn c() -> u32 { utf8_only() + float_only() }
fn parse_only() -> u32 { parse().unwrap() }
fn parse_utf8() -> u32 { parse_only() + utf8_only() }
fn io_float() -> u32 { single() + float_only() }
fn parse_float() -> u32 { parse_only() + float_only() }
fn io_parse_float() -> u32 { a() + float_only() }
fn io_utf8_float() -> u32 { b() + float_only() }
fn parse_utf8_float() -> u32 { parse_utf8() + float_only() }
fn all() -> u32 { nested() + float_only() }
fn domain() -> u32 { other_io().unwrap() + parse().unwrap() }
fn two_producers() -> u32 { io().unwrap() + other_io().unwrap() }
fn empty() -> u32 { 0 }
fn unknown() -> u32 { let _ = ::std::env::var("CORDIAL_SPECIMEN_MISSING"); a() }

fn main() {
    let _ = (a_third(), b_third(), nested_third(), single_third(), utf8_third(), c(),
        io_float(), parse_float(), io_parse_float(), io_utf8_float(), parse_utf8_float(), all(),
        domain(), two_producers(), empty(), unknown());
}
